takes.overview: The draft room went sideways but the roster didn't: this projects as the strongest team in the league, level with Al Dente, once Bedard returns from IR. The edge is the D corps (Seider, Bouchard, Clarke, Chychrun), which this blocks-heavy scoring rewards. The soft spot is the back of the forwards (Laferriere, Zacha, McKenna): that's where adds and trade chips should go. Watch Hellebuyck's suspension this week.
takes.matchup: Week 1 is a 13-day opener, and Angie's has about 12 more projected starts - that's the whole gap. Volume fixes it: use the Streaming tab's adds on your many open skater slots early in the window.
takes.roster: Hold the four top D; they're the edge. Bedard sits on IR, so his slot costs nothing now and he's worth a lot once back. Hellebuyck is starting in net while listed SUSPENSION: confirm before each game and slide Greaves in if he can't go.
takes.free_agents: Hartman for Laferriere is the clean rest-of-season upgrade: more points and a full playoff-week schedule. Keep all three goalies until Hellebuyck's status is clear.
takes.trades: The best realistic idea is Tuch + Chychrun to Torts for Makar: consolidation into a star, and Torts gains depth too, so it's a pitch they can say yes to. Tuch is the chip to sell - ESPN ranks him far higher than your projections do.
takes.playoffs: Your playoff weeks look average (6-7 games for most of the roster). Gauthier, Dorofeyev and McKenna have light schedules (5 games) - if you move forwards later, move them first.
